description: Latest public tender and contract items from three official sources in one answer: EU TED notices (last 30 days, buyer country optional), UK Find a Tender notices, and US federal contract awards (USAspending, last 30 days). Each item names its source. Not a complete list of any one market. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
